sections.title: Open desk
sections.sql: select number,claimant,owner,evidence_waiting,review_current,age_days from claim_desk where status='open' order by age_days desc

sections.title: Service dates
sections.sql: select number,owner,obligation,due_date from service_diary order by due_date nulls first

sections.title: Requests still waiting
sections.sql: select number,owner,description,requested_from,due_date,days_overdue from evidence_chase order by due_date

sections.title: Items for a handler to check
sections.note: Stored deadlines are confirmed by the operator. This is not a legal compliance certificate.
sections.sql: select number,rule,finding from compliance_findings order by number,rule
